qualifiedVerdicts.content: Blind facet-split reviews of the signed candidate 6947a60 and serialized fix rechecks of 330e621 found the original quiz-safety and comprehensibility defects resolved; correctness was clean from the start, including a post-blind Gramota check of nine Russian lexical choices. 被害's opening definition now says «с точки зрения того, кто их понёс» instead of «увиденные…», which could read as harm that was seen; 被る's source-list provenance note renders the English gloss "to suffer" as «страдать»; 覚ます is retitled «пробуждать; выводить из сна» so that it no longer repeats 起す «будить»; 見舞い names お as the polite prefix; and 解く's nuance warning names its own gloss «развязывать». Final verdicts: correctness CLEAN; scoped coverage CLEAN; comprehensibility CLEAN; consistency CLEAN; quiz safety CLEAN within reviewed batch scope. Full initial reviewer reports, reconciliation, the preserved author/reviewer required-versus-conservative exclusion classification and process notes are attached. No native-speaker, app-import, device, learner, voice, drawing, runtime or ordinary-release acceptance is claimed.

qualifiedVerdicts.quizTitles: All 20 EN exclusions across 13 lists are retained. The reviewed RU title overlaps received 27 direct, one-sided exclusions on 14 new cards: 解決–決定/解く/解ける/決める; 解ける–解く/決まる; 解く–決める; 観察–見物; 親友–友人/友達/友; 覚ます–起す; 見舞い–訪問/訪ねる/伺う; 偉い–立派/感心/偉大/優秀/大した; 上等–すばらしい; 見事–凄い; 要素–部分; 要点–中心; 製品–品物; 被る–着る/履く. Two were added after review: 見事–凄い and 解決–決める. 覚ます's title was reworded after review from «будить; пробуждать» to «пробуждать; выводить из сна» (EN "awaken; bring out of sleep") to remove the exact title overlap with 起す «будить»; the 覚ます–起す guard is kept because both still denote waking. Android applies each declaration symmetrically, so no reverse declarations were added to baseline cards.
